commit.message:
test(ci): align verifier contention deadlines

Share the startup deadline across synchronized verifier processes and
begin the completion budget after releasing both contenders. Retain the
exclusive writer assertions and cover delayed peer startup.

build: adopt qualified dependency sources

Align the recorded dependencies, module tool and CI execution with the
qualified Platform and Builds publications. Retain historical receipts
and record the current source selections.
